Copy.

D.C.I.
Sir,
This case concluded on the 5th December after a
protracted hearing, defendants being arrested on the 21st
October.

They were charged with:-
(a) Larceny by trick,
(b) Conspiracy.
Result:- Convicted on (a) charge.
(b) dismissed.
1st Defendant (Van Nowachinsky) 6 months H.L.
and pay $125.--, or one month, concurrent, towards cost of
prosecution, $125.-- not paid.
2nd defendant (Hodan) 4 months H.L. and pay
$125.-- or one month, consecutively, towards cost of
prosecution, fine paid. Both recommended for banishment.
Case No.21128/9.

Ring to be returned to pawnbroker, but
defendants can redeem if they wish to do so by applying to the
P.M. (ticket lost). The substituted ring was returned to
defendants, also a ring put in by the defence and another
diamond ring pawned by 1st defendant and found on 2nd
defendant when arrested. (All exhibits).

(Su.) A. REYNOLDS.
C.D.I.
7.12.31.
page_data.zh:
副本。

首席侦探督察
先生，
本案在经过漫长的审讯后，于12月5日结案，被告于10月21日被捕。

他们被指控：
(a) 诈骗盗窃，
(b) 共谋。
结果：(a) 项罪名成立。
(b) 项驳回。
第一被告（Van Nowachinsky）判处苦役6个月，并支付诉讼费125元，否则加判监禁1个月，刑期合并执行；125元未付。
第二被告（Hodan）判处苦役4个月，并支付诉讼费125元，否则加判监禁1个月，刑期连续执行；罚款已付。建议将两人驱逐出境。
案件编号 21128/9。

戒指将归还当铺，但被告如有意愿，可向裁判司署申请赎回（票据遗失）。作为替代品的戒指已归还被告，此外还有辩方提交的一枚戒指，以及由第一被告典当并在逮捕第二被告时在其身上发现的另一枚钻戒。（所有物证）。

（签）A. REYNOLDS.
首席侦探督察
31年12月7日。

23rd October, 1931.

**〔此处转录不清：左侧手写符号〕**

Sir,

I have the honour to enclose herewith finger-prints
and photos of two males who stand charged in this Colony
on ,— A. Larceny by Trick of a gold finger ring.
B. Conspiracy to commit a larceny.
The particulars of each are as follows:-

1. VAN NOWACZYNSKI, native of Warsaw, born in
May 1888, profession, butcher, medium height, stout
build, bald headed, present, clean shaven, holding
Polish Passport No. 3724, Ser. C. No. 029151, bearing
British Consulate-General visa, Shanghai, dated
5.10.31. Shanghai to Canton via Hong Kong.

2. ABDUL KODAN alias FENDAN, native of Persia, age
32 years, profession, music hall artist, medium height,
slender build, dark complexion, small black
moustache, with wife and child, holding French
passport No. 756 issued in Manila, bearing British
Consulate-General visa, Shanghai, dated 31st August
1931 Shanghai to Portugal, speaks Russian and English
These two men are reported to have arrived in this
Colony on the 16th October, 1931.

The fraud which they worked was for No. 1 to take a
valuable ring to a pawnshop and obtaining a loan on it,
in this case $600. A day or so later No. 1 called at the
pawnshop with No. 2 and asked to see the ring, making out

先生：

谨随函附上两名男子的指纹和照片，他们在本地殖民地受以下指控：— A. 诈骗盗窃金戒指一枚。
B. 共谋实施盗窃。
各自详情如下：-

1. VAN NOWACZYNSKI，华沙人，生于1888年5月，职业屠夫，中等身材，体格粗壮，秃顶，目前面部光洁无胡须，持有波兰护照第3724号，C系列第029151号，持英国驻上海总领事馆签证，日期为31年10月5日。行程：上海经香港至广州。

2. ABDUL KODAN，别名 FENDAN，波斯人，年龄32岁，职业歌舞厅艺人，中等身材，体型瘦削，肤色黝黑，留黑色小胡子，携妻儿同行，持有在马尼拉签发的法国护照第756号，持英国驻上海总领事馆签证，日期为1931年8月31日。行程：上海至葡萄牙，讲俄语和英语。
据报道，这两人于1931年10月16日抵达本殖民地。

他们实施的欺诈手段是：由1号将一枚贵重戒指拿到当铺抵押借款，本案中金额为600元。一两天后，1号偕同2号前往当铺，要求查看该戒指，声称

2.

that No.2 would buy, while this was going on a greatly
inferior ring of a similar design would be substituted,
the men leaving the pawnshop with the original ring in
their possession.

They were arrested while going into another
pawnbroker's shop on a like errand.

I would be greatly obliged if you could let
me have any records of these men which may be in your
possession and also if you would treat this letter as
very urgent. In both Passports the word "clerical"
(chief branch) has been crossed out - probably by the
holder ?

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Mcndue

他们在前往另一家当铺企图故技重施时被捕。

如蒙惠赐您所掌握的关于此二人的任何记录，并将此信视为极急件处理，本人将不胜感激。在两本护照中，“文书”（主要分支）一词已被划去——可能是持有人所为？
